segments.sn24.18:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.18:1.3: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.18:2.1: “rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.18:2.2: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti…pe….
segments.sn24.18:3.4: vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.18:3.5: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.7: “Yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.9: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.18:3.11: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.18:3.12: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.18:4.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu ca ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhasamudayepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti –
segments.sn24.18:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano”ti.
segments.sn24.18:5.2: so attā no ca me siyā;
segments.sn24.18:6.3: Anantavā ca taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti;
segments.sn24.18:7.3: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti. 2.

lines: Antavā lokoti ekato vaḍḍhitanimittaṃ lokoti gāhena vā takkena vā uppannadiṭṭhi.
Anantavāti sabbato vaḍḍhitaṃ appamāṇanimittaṃ lokoti gāhena vā takkena vā uppannadiṭṭhi.
Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti jīvañca sarīrañca ekamevāti uppannadiṭṭhi.
Imāni tāva sotāpattimaggavasena aṭṭhārasa veyyākaraṇāni ekaṃ gamanaṃ. 2.

after.title: Dutiyagamanādivaggavaṇṇanā
lines: Tatrāpi aṭṭhāraseva veyyākaraṇāni, tato parāni “rūpī attā hotī”tiādīni aṭṭha veyyākaraṇāni, tehi saddhiṃ taṃ dutiyapeyyāloti vutto.
